datasets.title: CVA and Nutrition Status of Children Under Five and Pregnant and Lactating Women in the Somalia Food Crisis
datasets.description: This is data from a quasi-experimental prospective cohort study examining the impact of CVA on prevention of acute malnutrition among pregnant and lactating women and children under five years in 2017/18 in the context of the Somalia food crisis. Dataset contains min. underlying data for two forthcoming manuscripts.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/wv-somalia-cva-cu5-plw]
